name: Sunday Harbour View Sukhumvit 50 Hotel
detail: I stayed here recently. The location is a little odd being in the an industrial area, meaning lots of commercial lorries/containers. There is a little night market close to the property. If you walk to the main road from the hotel and turn left, then walk 200-300 meters near to the big temple there is a night market. Selling limited but delicious street food from sweets to savories. Also, at the On Nut station (They provide a free tuk tuk service to) there is a big Tesco supermarket, where they have a food courts offering a good selection of choices which are cheap to try. The staff here at the Ibis were friendly, professional and efficient. You were treated more as a person. The buffet breakfast was delicious. Ask for an omelette, which they will cook for you freshly. Be-aware though they tend to have groups of Chinese bus tours staying here nothing wrong with that but the breakfast area can get busy. The staff were talkative and helpful too. There are also a lot of mosquitoes.

name: Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Bangkok
detail: Overall, the service standards here are truly outstanding.

name: Palette Hi Hotel Bangkok
detail: The hotel environment was nice, clean, and comfortable.

name: Diamond Bangkok Hotel
detail: I liked the location. Usually I have stayed in the Banglamphu area, the backpacker place to stay. After staying there for the last 25 years whenever in Bangkok I felt like I needed a change so chose Siam area. I arrived very early, 7am, I was able to take a room at 9am. The staff at reception were not the friendliest, but at least I got my room early. The road in front of the hotel is very busy, but the room was quiet enough. The usual A/C. fridge, T.V. you expect at this price range. Wifi was good. I don't think the hotel had food, but around I found the best street food and cheap but great food restaurants I have found in Bangkok. The hotel is a ten minute walk to the massive MBK shopping mall and the impressive Siam Discovery Centre. I spent hours walking around these places until my feet were aching too much, how wonderful to have a foot massage later! Anyway, back to the hotel, it's a bit on the expensive side for me but is good value for money. For short stays in Bangkok with plenty of local shopping options I can recommend and will likely stay there again. Also close to the BTS Skytrain and Jim Thompson house.

name: The Landmark Bangkok
detail: The property exceeded our expectations in every aspect.

name: Night Hotel Bangkok - Asoke Sukhumvit 15
detail: I am going to book Dream hotel for the 4th time know!!!! This is the best affordable hotel in Bangkok to my opinion. The hotel is separated in 2 buildings. One hotel is without the swimming pool and the more expensive one (i guess) has the swimming pool. The buildings are 1 minut apart. I have stayed in both of the 2 buildings and they are absolutely great. The rooms are really fabulous and have great comfortable beds. With a nice blue lighting to switch on ore off. They have a perfect airo system. Breakfast is really perfect. You have International foods and Thai dishes. It is a great relaxing get away from Bangkok crowd, but with in 4 minutes you are in the nice crowded area. BTS station is very close, and also great dining area's. Or going out! I already recommended this hotel to two others and they were also very satisfied. So i Will book this for the 4th TIME!!!!!!

name: Romance Hotel Sukhumvit 97
detail: Hotel overall was great. Staff was very pleasant. Only thing is the location I would consider very far from central bangkok. Takes roughly 20mins++ bts if you intend.to go from hotel to BTS Siam and longer if you intend to go to Jatujak. Going by Taxi would be costly. The hotel would be ideal if you intend to go to Mega Bangna as you can get there by going to BTS Udom Suk and then taking the free shuttle bus from there. Another thing is walking from BTS Bangchak to the hotel is quite a distance so I wouldnt recommend anyone with a family or have problems walking due to the inconvenience. That aside we had a pleasant stay at the hotel. Would be great if the hotel could provide a buggy ride (i saw a buggy outside which was never used maybe for decor only) or some other form of transport to pick customers up from BTS bangchak to the hotel and back.

name: Ambassador Hotel Bangkok
detail: A regular visitor to Thailand I stayed in the excellent Ambassador Hotel on Soi 11off Sukhumvit this time. I say excellent because the standard is exactly how a €40+ per night 4 star in Bangkok should be.The Ambassador is a big property with many amenities. The reception area is huge and the staff are friendly and efficient. My luggage was taken from the Taxi and appeared in my room within minutes of me entering my room.The initial impression you get when you walk in to the reception area is 5 star but the rooms put it firmly back in the second division.They are not bad but quite basic. Everything works and at this price you can't ask for more. The WiFi is free and strong but does require constant re-entering of passwords which is annoying at first but you get used to it. Room cleaning is efficient and flexible. Long low timber ceiling corridors give it a kind of old cruise liner feel. Restaurants, Bars, Massage studio, Gym, Tailoring shops, health spa and several coffee shops are among it's many features. And of course that great location close to everything. Some of the best restaurants in Bangkok are here.The very expensive but superb El Gaucho Steakhouse,one of 2 in the area, is right next door. For Mexican try the Coyote across the road. And round the corner the Firehouse serves the best burgers in Bangkok. An Aussie Bar also across the road serves up the traditional full breakfast. I would recommend the Ambassador as a budget hotel without hesitation.

name: Mode Sathorn Hotel
detail: this is my favorite hotel in Bangkok and I keep on coming back to it. I really give it five stars through and through with that there is a consistent problem with their Plumbing... Every time that I checked in, I needed to call somebody to come and unplug the toilet and after that things worked fine. as well there is a lot of natural light in the room but the artificial light is very limited. And the location of electricity sockets in the room could be improved. but I'm really nitpicking they have great facilities and staff restaurant gym pool Etc And the best breakfast in Bangkok

name: Rambuttri Village Hotel
detail: My favorite hotel in Bangkok at economy prices. While this is not the cheapest hotel around Khao San rd it offers the best value for money and still quite inexpensive. It is very clean and comfortable and the staff performance has improved significantly with years. While it doesn't have it's own restourant, it is located inside a small village of shops and has all the conveniences at hand. Roof top pool is a nice touch.
